description: The four canonical background relevance tiers.

none.label: None
none.description: Explicitly classified as not-relevant. Signals like sports tragedies, game projects, lifestyle pieces. Stored fully, never surfaced on the default dashboard.

low.label: Low
low.description: Stored, queryable, doesn't surface unprompted on the firehose. Visible inside topic or case context if it matches.
examples: domain news that doesn't match any active case

medium.label: Medium
medium.description: Surfaces in topic and case context but not on the firehose. Default classification when uncertain.
examples: news from a relevant topic that doesn't yet match a specific case

high.label: High
high.description: Surfaces everywhere by default, drives chronicle inclusion, may fire alerts depending on case rules.
examples: PAC-3 contract when Patriot tracking case is active
named target appearing in any source
verified strike report in active conflict zone

transition_rules.promote_on_new_match: Signal previously classified medium can be promoted to high when a new case observable matches its entities
transition_rules.demote_on_case_closure: Signal classified high because of a specific case can demote to medium when that case closes
transition_rules.audit_log: All transitions logged in provenance.extraction_passes with stage='relevance'
